title: Generic Defaults Prefill Button
primary_user_story: As a user, I can open /projects/new, choose Generic Solar or Generic Wind, click 'Use generic defaults', and get a reasonable prefilled exploratory case that I can immediately save, run, and modify.
scope: Generic exploratory path only. TUHO / Oborovo factory paths preserved.

server.purpose: Read-only JSON endpoint that returns all 16 form fields for generic_solar / generic_wind.
Server-side prefill for non-JS clients. Renders the form with all 16 fields populated.

helper.name: _generic_prefill_values
helper.purpose: Pure function: returns dict[str, str] of form fields for a given template_source, or None for non-generic sources.

changes: EXPLORATORY notice (inp-exploratory-notice) at the top of the form
np-prefill-hint (small text explaining the source of the defaults)
All 16 input fields have id='np-...' attributes
Inline vanilla-JS shim (no jQuery, no Tailwind, no Alpine)

helper returns Solar for generic_solar, Wind for generic_wind
all 16 form fields present and non-empty
opex_y1_keur matches sum of opex items

covers: tuho / oborovo / unknown return 400 (no factory leakage)
